**Jesús Martínez Padilla** · Senior Researcher, Pyrenean Institute of Ecology

My main interest lies in the evolutionary ecology of animal behaviour, particularly the role of environmental conditions in understanding its consequences at ecological and evolutionary timescales, within both temporal and biogeographical contexts. I am also interested in applying my knowledge to the conservation of threatened species in mountainous areas. In my research, I use a combination of field-based experiments and long-term, individually-based datasets, mostly in the wild in mountainous areas. I combine quantitative genetic, genetic, genomics and biogeographical tools to understand patterns and disentangle mechanisms.
